data.content: Plan attached as a note. Add LeaseOwner{machine_id,pid} to LeaseData; new src/machine.rs resolves a stable opaque machine id (KNOTS_MACHINE_ID env -> <store_root>/machine-id file -> sha256 of /etc/machine-id or random uuid, persisted). create_lease stamps the owner. New db queries count_local_active_leases/list_local_active_leases use COALESCE(json_extract(lease_data_json,'$.owner.machine_id'), ?1) = ?1 so legacy owner-less leases stay local. replication.rs guards switch to the local count. owner round-trips through parse_lease_data by serde alone. UI surfaces lease_owner in kno show and kno lease list. No child knots. Watch the 499-line cap on src/replication.rs (487) and src/run_commands.rs (489); replication sync test goes in a new src/replication/tests_lease_owner.rs. Changeset required before push.
